title: Simply Quests
description: A Progression Quest Mod for Minecraft 26.1+
body:
## **<center><font color="cyan">Simply Quests!</font></center>**

![Shows a simple Quest Line with Text and Images on the Canvas.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06d0785d0e0133d3235da429d2dee84b491a2501.png)

<font color="red">
This is a Beta release for a Questing Mod for Minecraft version 26.1+ that I have been working on. I am sure there are plenty of bugs, please feel free to let me know of issues via the Issue Tracker.
</font>

## **<font color="cyan">Questing!</font>**

Open the quest window by clicking the quest book in your inventory screen or by pressing the O key. The quest book can be dragged to a desired position.

Create Quests for other players to undertake and reward them for completing tasks. All Quests reside in Chapters. Chapters can either be Standalone, or they can be contained within Groups.

## **<font color="cyan">Progression!</font>**

Every Quest can be unlocked by completing Dependencies, or if you just want a free standing Quest, that is fine too. As you work your way through the Quest Line, the colors change and update for both Quests and the lines that connect to them.

## **<font color="cyan">Collaborate!</font>**

Simply Quests works in a Server Environment. So if you are part of a Team working on a Modpack, everyone can join a Server and work on Quest Lines together. When a player begins editing a Quest, that Quest gets locked to prevent players from overwriting each others work. Changes apply in real time, so you can see changes from other players as it happens.

## **<font color="cyan">Secure!</font>**

Ability to Edit Quests is a 2 step process. Players must be an Operator in the game (Commands enabled) and they must have Editing Enabled. Editing can be enabled by typing the following command: 
```
/simplyquests enableEditMode true
```

## **<font color="cyan">Customize!</font>**

All of the UI Elements of this mod can be Customized within the Settings panel found by clicking the gear icon in the Side Bar.
![Color Settings Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6104c7a77457a19bb22bc4cea76cab2c7b5f99bb.png)

## **<font color="red">Note:</font>**
I am not great at writing Descriptions! If you feel that I have missed any important information, please let me know and I will adjust everything as needed!
